calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.store_weeks, ly.store_weeks AS ly_sw, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region NULLS FIRST

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.format, s.open_date, s.close_date, s.valid_from, s.valid_to, s.is_current, c.closure_start_date, c.closure_end_date
FROM dim_store s LEFT JOIN ref_store_closure c ON c.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE s.is_current AND (s.open_date IS NOT NULL OR s.close_date IS NOT NULL OR c.store_id IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY s.store_id

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS m
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
    GROUP BY 1,2
), ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS c
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND r.store_id < 900
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(mine.fiscal_year, ctl.fiscal_year) AS fy, COALESCE(mine.store_id, ctl.store_id) AS store_id, mine.m, ctl.c, ROUND(mine.m - ctl.c, 2) AS gap
FROM mine FULL JOIN ctl ON mine.fiscal_year = ctl.fiscal_year AND mine.store_id = ctl.store_id
WHERE mine.m IS NULL OR ctl.c IS NULL OR ABS(mine.m - ctl.c) > 0.5
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_receipt_lines, min(f.sale_date) AS mind, max(f.sale_date) AS maxd, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.etl_loaded_at IS NULL) AS no_etl
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH days AS (
    SELECT calendar_date, fiscal_year, is_trading_day FROM dim_date
    WHERE fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
), st AS (SELECT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900),
act AS (
    SELECT r.store_id, r.business_date, r.net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r WHERE r.store_id < 900
)
SELECT st.store_id, st.store_name, d.fiscal_year,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.is_trading_day) AS trading_days,
       count(a.business_date) FILTER (WHERE a.net_sales <> 0) AS days_with_sales,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT d.is_trading_day AND a.net_sales <> 0) AS closed_days_with_sales,
       round(sum(a.net_sales)) AS net
FROM st CROSS JOIN days d LEFT JOIN act a ON a.store_id = st.store_id AND a.business_date = d.calendar_date
GROUP BY 1,2,3
HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.is_trading_day) <> count(a.business_date) FILTER (WHERE a.net_sales <> 0) OR count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT d.is_trading_day AND a.net_sales <> 0) > 0
ORDER BY 1,3
